title: Purple Lady seen on first DMT trip

tellings.quote: >> So but you know Purple Lady I saw when I did DMT the first time

plain: The comedian Kurt Metzger says that the first time he took DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, he saw a figure he calls the Purple Lady. He tells it as his own experience, in passing, during a conversation with the host about hidden powers and otherworldly beings, hinting that the figure he met may be something real.
